scope: Phase 10D physical discovery rerun of real vertical Quartz wheel delivery after correcting two stale documentation guards; no public raw-wheel API is frozen

contractFailures: Phase 10B semantic fallback documentation regex expected an older phrase no longer present in the canonical compressed Phase 10 document
Phase 10C evidence regex expected 'no emergency release' without the now-canonical 'fixture' qualifier

s02Corrections.purpose: Make documentation guards assert current semantic boundaries rather than brittle editorial wording while preserving all historical evidence and the exact wheel physical harness.

expectedPhysicalEvidence.negativeDelivery: ProbeScrollView observes at least one scrollWheel event after wheel1=-3
expectedPhysicalEvidence.negativeConsequence: documentVisibleRect origin changes in the observed qualitative direction
expectedPhysicalEvidence.positiveDelivery: ProbeScrollView observes at least one scrollWheel event after wheel1=+3
expectedPhysicalEvidence.positiveConsequence: documentVisibleRect origin changes in the opposite qualitative direction after baseline reset
expectedPhysicalEvidence.signMappingFromS01: wheel1=-3 produced increasing-y; wheel1=+3 produced decreasing-y on the reference Mac
expectedPhysicalEvidence.restoration: original pointer and previous frontmost application are restored
expectedPhysicalEvidence.privacy: fixture coordinates, numeric scroll offsets and native display identifiers are not persisted

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the controlled fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: A contract guard, delivery, real scroll consequence, opposite-sign mapping, baseline reset, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariant fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: All contract tests pass and both raw wheel signs are physically delivered to the test-owned AppKit scroll fixture, independently change scroll state in opposite directions, and cleanup succeeds without creating a public API.

nextStepOnPass: Use authoritative s02 physical sign/delivery evidence to freeze a narrow public raw-wheel contract while keeping semantic ui.scroll preferred, then validate that public API separately.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not add or promote a raw-wheel public capability.
